title: Concurrent projects: per-project ports and clear port conflicts
objective: Several generated projects (and the blueprint) can run ./dev up at the same time without editing configuration; a busy port fails clearly; readiness confirms this project's own servers; containers left without published ports are recreated.
acceptance_criteria: Two generated projects run ./dev up concurrently and both pass ./dev test --system
./dev up names the busy port and the process holding it instead of failing obscurely
Readiness waits on this project's own processes, not whatever answers on the port
The generator assigns a deterministic per-project port block; an environment override exists; the blueprint keeps its documented ports
